column1: # What MySQL 8.4.13 answers to UPPER() and LOWER() for every code point
# (surrogates aside) that some collation changes, recorded 2026-11-20 on the
# reference server with build/casing/dump.sql. Each line: the code point in
# decimal, then UPPER and LOWER in hex under utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci,
# utf8mb4_general_ci and utf8mb4_bin, then the character itself in hex.
# Every code point not listed is unchanged by all three.
